reference_range_has_a_bound.name: reference_range_has_a_bound
reference_range_has_a_bound.value: "reference_ranges"."normal_low" IS NOT NULL OR "reference_ranges"."normal_high" IS NOT NULL

reference_range_normal_ordered.name: reference_range_normal_ordered
reference_range_normal_ordered.value: "reference_ranges"."normal_low" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."normal_high" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."normal_low" <= "reference_ranges"."normal_high"

reference_range_optimal_inside_normal.name: reference_range_optimal_inside_normal
reference_range_optimal_inside_normal.value:
("reference_ranges"."optimal_low" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."normal_low" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."optimal_low" >= "reference_ranges"."normal_low")
        AND ("reference_ranges"."optimal_high" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."normal_high" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."optimal_high" <= "reference_ranges"."normal_high")
        AND ("reference_ranges"."optimal_low" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."optimal_high" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."optimal_low" <= "reference_ranges"."optimal_high")

reference_range_age_ordered.name: reference_range_age_ordered
reference_range_age_ordered.value: "reference_ranges"."age_min_years" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."age_max_years" IS NULL OR "reference_ranges"."age_min_years" <= "reference_ranges"."age_max_years"
